name: PA-15
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong R partisan lean of R+19
Incumbent Thompson with large fundraising edge
model.rationale: The district's R+19 lean, Thompson's incumbency and roughly 13-to-1 fundraising advantage over Ray Bilger leave the Democrat with no visible path; markets price Thompson near 96%. The forecast stays close to fundamentals with a modest Democratic tilt from the favorable national environment.
model.watch: A major national Democratic wave or unexpected incumbent scandal could pull the margin into the low teens.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Glenn Thompson seeks another term in a north-central Pennsylvania district that leans Republican by about nineteen points. He has raised roughly $1.85 million and holds a large cash advantage over Democrat Ray Bilger, who has raised about $140,000 with little outside support on either side. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the picture rests on fundamentals and market pricing, which gives Thompson about a 96% chance of winning.

The Democratic ticket benefits from a favorable national environment this cycle, which could trim a few points off Thompson's margin, but the district's lean and his incumbency and financial edge make an upset very unlikely. The race is rated Safe Republican, with the main uncertainty being how large Thompson's winning margin turns out to be.
